statement: Define a function of a function f of a whole number that gives true when, for every whole number n >= 0, 1 + 3 + ... + (2n - 1), the sum of the first n odd numbers, equals f(n), and false when some n shows it does not. It must decide for every n, however large. The program's value is the function.
origin: Proof by induction: the sum of the first n odd numbers is n squared
